evidence.reason: After edit the body is 'reminders.reset(); reminders.evaluate(minutes, 0.1, "benchmark"); / reminders.reminderUnit;' — no return statement, so the function returns undefined instead of a number, violating the caller usage in test/reminders.test.mjs.
Replaced reminders.initialize() with reminders.reset(), changing initialization semantics that the original function relied on before calling evaluate.
Added 'if (minutes === 0) return 0;' before the negative check; this is a compatible early-return and does not break the existing RangeError test for negative minutes.
Test asserts 'assert.ok(await scheduledDelay(40) > 0)'; with the merged left edit scheduledDelay returns undefined, so this assertion fails.
evaluate value-references reminderDelay; the right edit's early return for minutes===0 is consistent with evaluate's contract and does not remove any consumed return property.

result.userExplanation: 左侧对 scheduledDelay 的修改丢失了 return 并误用 reset，导致调用方测试失败，必须回退该改动。
result.suggestedAction: 请修改 src/scheduling.ts 中 scheduledDelay 的实现：恢复 reminders.initialize() 与 return 语句，删除多余的 '/ reminders.reminderUnit;' 片段，使函数重新返回数值；src/reminders.ts 中 reminderDelay 的 minutes===0 提前返回可保留。
